rules.sentence: Apply appropriate pathologic and radiologic diagnostic tests to identify and stage leiomyosarcoma.
Determine the correct treatment algorithm for patients with localized and metastatic leiomyosarcoma.
Determine the most appropriate medical treatment for patients with leiomyosarcoma.
Prognosis is determined by the tumor's location, size, and grade, with tumor grade significantly affecting overall survival.
The current standard of care involves upfront surgical procedure for resectable tumors, with chemotherapy and radiation typically serving as adjuncts.
Treatment at high-volume sarcoma centers is preferred and associated with improved patient outcomes.
Consequently, clinicians should strongly encourage patients with leiomyosarcoma to participate in clinical trials at any stage of diagnosis.
